question_text: Passage: The National Budget Circular No. 2023-1, issued by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), provides guidelines for the implementation of the Fiscal Year 2023 General Appropriations Act. It mandates that all government agencies must submit their budget utilization reports on a quarterly basis. The circular also stipulates that any unexpended funds at the end of the fiscal year shall revert to the National Treasury, unless otherwise provided by law. Agencies are required to prioritize the completion of ongoing projects before initiating new ones. According to the passage, how often must agencies submit budget utilization reports?
